newsitem.title: USA: US Energy Secretary O'Leary to leave post Friday.
newsitem.headline: US Energy Secretary O'Leary to leave post Friday.

text.p: U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary's last regular day on the job will be Friday, the Energy Department said.
President Clinton named Transportation Secretary Federico Pena to replace O'Leary, who had said she planned to leave after four years.
The Senate Energy Committee has tentatively set a confirmation hearing for Pena for late this month.
